title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
statement_md:
Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the $k^{\text{th}}$ largest element in the array.

Note that it is the $k^{\text{th}}$ largest element in the sorted order, not the $k^{\text{th}}$ distinct element.

Can you solve it without sorting in $O(n)$ average time?

hints.text: A Min-Heap of size K maintains the K largest elements seen so far.
Push into min-heap; when size exceeds K, pop the smallest element.
At the end, top of min-heap is the kth largest element. Or use QuickSelect for O(n) average.

editorial_md:
### Optimal Approach: Min-Heap or QuickSelect
A min-heap of capacity $k$ keeps the $k$ greatest items in $O(n \log k)$ time and $O(k)$ space.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(n \log k)$ heap or $O(n)$ average QuickSelect
- **Space Complexity:** $O(k)$
